comment: Bristle strands differ in width, softness, length and tone. On a white 1600 by 800 document, a mid brown, Bristle Flat at a radius of 0.025 of the short side with a sample every 4 pixels, in the left half: a level stroke, a curve, a scrub of three times to and fro, and a short dab of 24 pixels, each at the presses 0.3, 0.6 and 0.9 from left to right. One look of the whole sheet at twice its size, whose right half stays blank for a reference picture, since no references folder under sara-godot/tests holds it.
